entities.name: Juan Gómez-Jurado
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Juan Gómez-Jurado is a Spanish journalist and author. He was a columnist in "La Voz de Galicia" and "ABC", distributed in Spain, and he participates in multiple radio and TV programs. His books have been translated into 42 languages and he is one of the most successful living Spanish authors, along with Javier Sierra and Carlos Ruiz Zafón. His writing has been described by critics as "energetic and cinematographic".
